result_blindness.purpose: Close a pre-execution ambiguity between scientific event deadlines and technical process supervision.

f23_human_contract.frozen_rule: Static 1800 seconds per run; CDF 300 seconds per event; rolling 120 seconds per event and the historical 2400-second instance ceiling.

r5_machine_contract.frozen_rule: Static, dynamic and rolling technical sequence hard ceilings are 3600, 21600 and 10800 seconds.

methods_semantic_corroboration.frozen_rule: Event REJECT_TIMEOUT is distinct from supervisor process, scheduling or infrastructure timeout.

scientific_event_deadline.continuous_endpoint: Use the last valid event archive at the common event cutoff and record a timeout indicator.

technical_sequence_or_global_timeout.partial_checkpoint_policy: Preserve the last safely committed partial checkpoint and all logs without fabricating later events.
technical_sequence_or_global_timeout.retry_policy: No automatic retry; any rerun requires the frozen result-blind deviation procedure.

supersession.f23_rolling_2400_second_instance_ceiling: Superseded for technical process supervision by the later R5 10800-second rolling sequence hard ceiling.
supersession.f23_event_deadlines: Retained as scientific event-level method-common ceilings because R5 did not replace them with event-level values.
supersession.r5_sequence_hard_ceilings: Retained only as supervisor technical sequence ceilings and must never be written as REJECT_TIMEOUT.

required_runtime_behavior: All DT-RAMDE variants and every comparator use the same suite-specific scientific event deadline.
The supervisor sequence marker remains independent of algorithm terminal selection.
A supervisor timeout produces a typed technical task outcome with no REJECT_TIMEOUT terminal.
Focused tests prove method symmetry, last-valid partial checkpoint preservation, exact charged-work accounting when cooperative shutdown succeeds, and fail-closed unknown accounting after hard kill.
implementation_gate.historical_drift_closed: The former per-sequence-to-DT-RAMDE-event misbinding is removed. DT-RAMDE and every comparator now use the suite-specific scientific event ceiling, while the supervisor retains separate sequence hard ceilings.
implementation_gate.verification: Focused timeout, partial-checkpoint, technical-failure, full-schedule-manifest and failure-cost validation tests pass; formal launch remains subject to independent target-host, source-identity and one-time authorization gates.
